title: Charming, Modern Nashville Home
description:
Welcome to your Nashville home base— 10 MINUTES FROM DOWNTOWN, The Gulch, the Airport, and 12th South! This cozy 3 BEDROOM, 2 FULL BATH, bright open living space, fast Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a functional kitchenette w/ hotplate, toaster oven, microwave (no range, no dishwasher) full-size refrigerator, WASHER AND DRYER, plus crib and highchair. Enjoy a FULLY FENCED front yard (NO PETS OVER 60 LBS), with quick access to I-440 and I-65. Beds (King, Queen, Double). No smoking on premises.

The space
Beautifully decorated and calm space. Three separate bedrooms and two full bathrooms. Spotlessly clean and a great fully fenced yard.

Other things to note
Street parking available with an additional parking space marked by a green flag on the side of the house.
